bequests.item: Support for her eldest son (brothers to check on him and give him money)

condition: Handwritten in a spiral notebook found under a couch cushion; signed 'A. Franklin' with a smiley face in the A. Names Kecalf Franklin executor (Ted White Jr. crossed out). The 2010 business-class condition is dropped. A Michigan jury ruled in July 2023 that this is her valid will.
